title: Pivotal coordinates of the addressing function
statement: Let $m\in\mathbb N$, and consider the addressing function on sign vectors with $m$ address coordinates and $2^m$ data coordinates: the address selects one data coordinate, whose sign is the output. For any input $x$ and coordinate $i$, if changing coordinate $i$ changes the output, then $i$ is either an address coordinate or the data coordinate selected by the address of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $m+2^m$
$i$ is a coordinate of that vector
Changing coordinate $i$ changes the addressing function's output at $x$
